notes: Fronts and backs are tied together even when your scanner names scans only by number or time, and a slow scanner is fine: a front waits for its back until the next card's front arrives.
Every graded card is saved to History and My collection as soon as it's graded (one card, a folder or a scan with several cards). Grading the same scan again updates its saved card.
History: Open shows a saved card's full page, and Delete cards… deletes some or all cards (a copy is saved first).
Slabs can be saved to My collection with the grade on their label.
